description: List the open refresh tasks in this workspace: memories or rules an agent flagged with `pathrule_request_refresh`. Each task points to a memory/rule that looks stale, with a plain-language reason and optional AI instructions. Call `pathrule_get_refresh_brief` for full context, then use your own file-access tools to investigate, call `pathrule_update_memory`/`pathrule_update_rule` with `refresh_id` to apply a fix, and finally `pathrule_resolve_refresh` to close the loop.

include_in_progress.description: Include tasks previously claimed (status='in_progress'). Default false — returns only freshly pending tasks.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID. Use the `workspace_id` surfaced by `pathrule_get_context` or the session digest.

name: pathrule_list_pending_refreshes
title: List pending memory/rule refresh tasks
